item.title: The Campus – Reagan Russell: The SCC is M.I.A.: A Symptom of a Bigger Extracurricular Issue at Bishop’s
item.dc:creator: Reagan Russell
item.description: This also speaks to a larger issue at Bishop’s: clubs failing to pass the baton to new Executive Teams. Ask almost anyone in a leadership role for a campus club, and they will tell you that emails, transition documents and passwords are constantly going missing. “They didn’tsign us into our email, and it took me like three weeks to get an answer,” says a President of a student club.
